description: This file defines a class GaugesGrid that encapsulates a Swing JPanel with a GridLayout, allowing to set the layout dynamically and initialize it with a specific number of rows and columns.

classes.name: GaugesGrid
classes.description: A class encapsulating a JPanel with a grid layout that can be dynamically configured.

methods.name: GaugesGrid
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the panel with a grid layout of specified rows and columns.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Method to update the grid layout of the panel with new rows and columns, and remove all existing components.
